_note: EXAMPLE. Copy to registry/policy.local.json (gitignored) and fill in your organization's model policy. Keep employer policy and internal usage figures in the .local file only - this repo is public. The build reads the profile matching -Preset; a local profile overrides that preset's role models and the cost figures shown in the Copilot instructions. Local builds are written to build/local/ so they can never be committed.
